integrity: All-parameter four-vertex proof; exact 32-profile five-vertex enumeration and extra finite-grid checks; no assertion that sampling proves the continuous theorem.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected undirected simple graphs, two actions, 0<gamma_i<1, no intrinsic payoff; sharp five-vertex example is not a global price-of-stability estimate. Neary–Newton (2017) full text not reviewed; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Five players are the sharp welfare–equilibrium separation threshold in binary network coordination
